name: Amaziah
overview: Amaziah was a male Levite belonging to the Merarite branch, descending from Merari, son of Levi. He is uniquely identified as the son of Hilkiah, situating him within the priestly tribe of Levi. His lineage connects him to the service of God through the Levitical families, specifically the Merarites.
namesAndTitles: The name Amaziah means 'YHWH is powerful,' reflecting a theologically significant declaration of God's strength. This proper name highlights a recognition of divine power, though it was not explicitly given by God according to the record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Amaziah as the son of Hilkiah and also infers Hashabiah as his father, indicating a generational link within the Levitical line. Beyond these connections, no additional family relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Amaziah's role as a Levite of the Merarite clan underscores his place within the sacred heritage of Israel's priestly service. His identification as Hilkiah's son aligns him with a lineage entrusted with temple duties. Though the prior references discuss a king named Amaziah, this Amaziah's significance lies primarily in his Levitical heritage and priestly responsibilities, emphasizing the continuity of God's ordained worship through the tribe of Levi.
